mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned Courageous Lake gold project, Northwest Territories (transferred from Seabridge Gold via spin-out effective June 3, 2026; trading began June 5, 2026). One of Canada's largest undeveloped gold projects: M&I 11.0 Moz Au (145.2 Mt @ 2.36 g/t); inferred 3.3 Moz Au (40.6 Mt @ 2.52 g/t); M&I includes 2.8 Moz proven & probable reserves. Among Canada's highest-grade open-pit gold projects. Seabridge seeded Valor with CA$10M (0.7M shares at CA$7.29 = CA$5.1M + 10% gold stream at fixed US$4,000/oz = CA$4.9M). No production.

notes: Pre-production developer; no FY2025 production or revenue. TSX:VGC (new company created by Seabridge Gold Inc. spin-out: Seabridge shareholders received 1 Valor share per ~1.957 Seabridge shares; 55M Valor shares outstanding). Company did not exist in FY2025; figures are Courageous Lake project data as disclosed by Seabridge at the spin-out (2026). Pure-play single-asset exposure; next catalysts: updated economic study, drilling, and financing (CA$10M treasury). All figures in CAD unless noted.
